layout_note: Use the real LOSVER code plus Devign, Big-Vul, and PrimeVul through dataset_candidate/losver/. Function-level labels are included. Line-level GT for Big-Vul and PrimeVul can be recovered from before/after function pairs. Devign line-level GT is precomputed in devign/*_with_lines.jsonl (field lines_ground_truth) and can be regenerated offline from the bare FFmpeg/qemu clones under dataset_candidate/losver/repos.
copy_note: The shared package is read-only. Copy source_code/ and selected dataset jsonl files into project/ before editing scripts or writing checkpoints.

instance_layout.note: Paper further filters Devign to 19,771 (UniXcoder 512-token, at least one modifiable line in window) and Big-Vul to 6,924 / 36 CWE IDs. PrimeVul uses the paired splits without extra filtering. The mounted PrimeVul paired train has 7,578 functions (HuggingFace colin/PrimeVul); the paper text cites 8,708.

line_level_ground_truth.devign: Precomputed in devign/*_with_lines.jsonl. Field lines_ground_truth holds 0-based indices of modified lines within func; [-1] means the patched function could not be recovered (see line_gt_status). Filter those out, as the authors' convert_examples_to_features does.
line_level_ground_truth.bigvul: Derive by diffing func_before against func_after in MSR_data_cleaned.jsonl.
line_level_ground_truth.primevul: Derive from the paired vulnerable/patched records sharing a commit_id.

python_environment.note: Prepared automatically at container startup with CPU torch + transformers; do not recreate a host .venv inside the shared mount. Reinstall a CUDA wheel only if GPU is available.

not_provided.figshare_checkpoints: Author UniXcoder checkpoints are not mounted; train from scratch or document omission.
not_provided.pretrained_plms: UniXcoder / CodeBERT / CodeT5+ weights are not pre-cached; download with source_code/download_unixcoder.py or transformers.
